SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.TRANSACTION_ID AS TRANSACTION_ID FROM PHACPDT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SEND_YN = 'N' AND A.TOCOMPANY_ID = 'KEP' AND TO_CHAR(A.ACP_DT,'YYYYMMDD') >= '20130301' AND ROWNUM < 51
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KA' AS SITE, 'STX2' AS BUYER, CASE WHEN A.LEGACY_FLAG = 'A' THEN 'C' WHEN A.LEGACY_FLAG = 'C' THEN 'R' WHEN A.LEGACY_FLAG = 'D' THEN 'D' END AS STATUS, A.PO_NO AS LEGACY_PO_NO, (SELECT MAX(PO_SEQ) FROM PFPODMROT_KEP WHERE PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND ITEM_NO = A.PART_CD AND ITEM_CLASS = A.PART_CLASS) AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, A.PART_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, A.CURRENCY_CD AS CURRENCY_CODE, A.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, A.ACP_QTY AS GR_QTY, A.ACP_AMOUNT AS GR_AMT, TO_CHAR(A.ACP_DT,'YYYYMMDD') AS GR_DATE, A.ASN_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO, A.TRANSACTION_ID AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM PHACPDT A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TRANSACTION_ID = '$G_RS.TRANSACTION_ID$'
UPDATE PHACPDT A SET SEND_YN = 'Y', SYS_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.TRANSACTION_ID = '$G_RS.TRANSACTION_ID$'
